preconditions.description: The number of nodes must be between 1 and 100.
The number of edges must be between 0 and 10000.
The number of spaceships and bases must be between 1 and 1000.
The cost of having a base attacked and the cost of creating a dummy base must be non-negative and within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum gold lost in terms of gold.
